title: The Feast at the Farm
offer: The guests come! But some have no boat: bring Old Grim from Svanetorp, Old Halvard from Solby, and Tova from her island. Then the feast begins!

steps.load_say: A feast for an old man? I bring my cow's best butter!
One more trip with my favourite skippers! Did I tell you about the sea serpent?
My apprentices, healers now, and rowing me to a feast. I am proud of you.

steps.say: Everybody is here: the people and the animals of all the lakes, music and torches and songs. Look what you made of an old boat, three hens and a sheep.

reward.gift: the friendship of all the Home Lakes

fact: Next spring, the way to the Long Lake opens: new lakes, new friends, new adventures.
